# Inngest API

- [API Overview](/): Complete reference documentation for the Inngest REST API.
- [Authentication](/authentication): How to authenticate with the Inngest REST API.
- v1
  - [v1 REST API](/v1)

  - **Events**
  - [List events](/v1/events/ListEvents): Fetches recent events from your environment.
  - [Get an event](/v1/events/GetEvent): Retrieve a single event within your environment, given its internal ID
  - [List event function runs](/v1/events/ListEventRuns): Returns function runs initialized by the given event

  - **Function runs**
  - [Get a function run](/v1/function-runs/GetRun): Returns a single function run by its run ID
  - [Cancel a function run](/v1/function-runs/CancelRun): Cancels a running function immediately.  No new steps will run after a function is cancelled.
  - [Fetch function run jobs](/v1/function-runs/GetRunJobs): An endpoint to fetch a subset of the function run's jobs within the function_id queue, in order of earliest to latest. This primarily allows you to see the order of the run's jobs within the function queue.

A single function enqueues all function run jobs wihtin the same queue.  This endpoint fetches a subset of jobs for a given function run.

This endpoint is rate limited and cached for 5 seconds.

  - **Signals**
  - [Resume signal](/v1/signals/ResumeSignal): Sends data to resume a given signal

  - **Cancellations**
  - [List cancellations](/v1/cancellations/ListCancellations): Returns all cancellations in your environment
  - [Create a cancellation](/v1/cancellations/CreateCancellation): Creates a bulk cancellation, cancelling all functions in the given time range matching an optional expression
  - [Delete a cancellation](/v1/cancellations/DeleteCancellation): Delete a cancellation, preventing the cancellation from stopping function runs between the given dates with a given expression.

  - **Webhooks**
  - [Get webhooks](/v1/webhooks/ListWebhooks): Get all webhook endpoints in the given environment.
  - [Create webhook](/v1/webhooks/CreateWebhook): Create a new webhook endpoint with the given configuration.
  - [Get webhook](/v1/webhooks/GetWebhook): Get a webhook endpoint's configuration
  - [Delete webhook](/v1/webhooks/DeleteWebhook): Delete a webhook endpoint
  - [Update webhook](/v1/webhooks/UpdateWebhook): Update a webhook endpoint's configuration
- v2

  - **Account**
  - [Get account](/v2/account/FetchAccount): Returns the account for the authenticated user

  - **Apps**
  - [Get apps](/v2/apps/GetApps): Lists active apps in the authenticated environment. Set archived to true to list archived apps instead.
  - [Get app](/v2/apps/GetApp): Fetches details for a single app, including sync metadata and function count
  - [List app syncs](/v2/apps/ListAppSyncs): Lists app syncs newest first. Cloud keeps syncs until the app is deleted, with no separate retention window. The dev server does not support sync history and returns 501 for both list and get. Use GetApp latestSync for the dev server's current state.
  - [Sync app](/v2/apps/SyncApp): Sync an app at the provided URL.
  - [Get app sync](/v2/apps/GetAppSync): Gets an app sync. Cloud keeps syncs until the app is deleted, with no separate retention window. The dev server does not support sync history and returns 501 for both list and get. Use GetApp latestSync for the dev server's current state.

  - **Functions**
  - [Get functions](/v2/functions/GetFunctions): Lists function configuration and status details for an app
  - [Pause functions](/v2/functions/PauseFunctions): Pauses functions in one app. Idempotent. Accepts up to 500 unique IDs, at most 256 bytes each, in a body of at most 256 KiB of JSON. Split larger sets into multiple requests. Cloud limits bulk calls to a lower rate (about 1 per 5 seconds on most plans), so quick retries can get a 429. Returns one result per ID in request order; failures do not stop the rest. An unknown app returns 200 with not_found for every ID, so check each result. The path app ID is used; any appId in the body is ignored. Running work may continue. In Cloud, pauses can take up to a minute to apply, new runs are skipped, and unfinished runs are cancelled after 7 days paused. In the dev server, pauses apply immediately, new runs stay queued, and pauses last until resumed or restarted. Wait for each pause or resume request to finish before sending the opposite action; confirm with GetFunction after the cache refreshes and retry if needed.
  - [Resume functions](/v2/functions/ResumeFunctions): Resumes functions in one app. Idempotent. Accepts up to 500 unique IDs, at most 256 bytes each, in a body of at most 256 KiB of JSON. Split larger sets into multiple requests. Cloud limits bulk calls to a lower rate (about 1 per 5 seconds on most plans), so quick retries can get a 429. Returns one result per ID in request order; failures do not stop the rest. An unknown app returns 200 with not_found for every ID, so check each result. The path app ID is used; any appId in the body is ignored. In Cloud, the response reflects the requested state; resumes can take up to a minute to apply. Future scheduled pauses return per-function errors and stay unchanged. Skipped runs are not recreated. In the dev server, each queue is woken before its pause is cleared; a failed wake leaves that function paused. Retries wake queues again. Wait for each pause or resume request to finish before sending the opposite action; confirm with GetFunction after the cache refreshes and retry if needed.
  - [Get function](/v2/functions/GetFunction): Fetches function configuration and status details for a function within an app
  - [Invoke function](/v2/functions/InvokeFunction): Invokes a function, executing the function either asynchronously or synchronously based on the mode parameter in the request body
  - [Pause a function](/v2/functions/PauseFunction): Pauses a function. Idempotent: pausing a paused function returns 200 and changes nothing. Send no request body. Runs already executing may continue. In Cloud, the pause can take up to a minute to apply, new runs are skipped while paused, and runs still unfinished after 7 days paused are cancelled, same as pausing in the dashboard. Wait for a pause or resume to finish before sending the opposite action: requests sent close together can be skipped or apply out of order. Confirm with GetFunction after the cache has refreshed and retry if needed. In the dev server, the pause applies right away, new runs stay queued, and it lasts until resumed or restarted. Use PauseFunctions to pause up to 500 functions in one request.
  - [Resume a function](/v2/functions/ResumeFunction): Resumes a paused function. Idempotent: resuming a function that is not paused returns 200 with isPaused: false. The dev server still wakes the queue so retries can recover a failed wake. Send no request body. In Cloud, the response reflects the requested state; the resume can take up to a minute to apply. A future scheduled pause returns 409 and is left unchanged. New runs skipped while paused are not recreated. Wait for a pause or resume to finish before sending the opposite action: requests sent close together can be skipped or apply out of order. Confirm with GetFunction after the cache has refreshed and retry if needed. In the dev server, resume clears the pause after waking the queue; a failed wake leaves the pause in place. Queued runs can then start. Use ResumeFunctions to resume up to 500 functions in one request.

  - **Runs**
  - [Create a cancellation](/v2/runs/CreateCancellation): Cancels a function's runs queued between from and until, inclusive, with millisecond precision. until may be up to now plus five seconds. There is no cap on range width; a from far in the past includes all queued runs through until. Includes runs that have never started, even when the function is paused. Running runs stop before their next step; sleeping or waiting runs are cancelled when they next resume. A step already executing may finish. The optional if expression filters the triggering event. Returns 201 when created; cancellation happens asynchronously. Not idempotent: each request creates another cancellation.
  - [Create replay](/v2/runs/CreateReplay): Creates an asynchronous replay for matching runs of one function. Cloud bounds have millisecond precision: from rounds down; until includes the end of its millisecond. Dev server bounds are inclusive at stored timestamp precision. Dev server replays run in memory and are lost on restart. Requests are not idempotent: retrying creates another replay. In Inngest Cloud, replays are listed on the function's Replays page in the dashboard. Scheduling is best effort and does not preserve event order.
  - [List runs for a function](/v2/runs/ListFunctionRuns): Lists runs for one function in the authenticated environment
  - [Get event runs](/v2/runs/GetEventRuns): Lists function runs triggered by a specific event
  - [List runs](/v2/runs/ListRuns): Lists runs in the authenticated environment, optionally filtered by app and function IDs
  - [Get function run](/v2/runs/GetFunctionRun): Fetches the canonical run summary for a single function run
  - [Cancel function run](/v2/runs/CancelRun): Cancels an in-progress function run
  - [Rerun function run](/v2/runs/Rerun): Creates a new run using the original run's triggering event data
  - [Create score](/v2/runs/CreateScore): Submits one or more named scores for a function run, or for specific steps when step IDs are provided. Scores are recorded as run metadata and aggregated for experiments.
  - [Get function trace](/v2/runs/GetFunctionTrace): Fetches the trace tree for a single function run

  - **Experiments**
  - [List experiments for a function](/v2/experiments/ListExperiments2): Lists observed experiments for one function in the authenticated environment.
  - [Get experiment aggregates](/v2/experiments/GetExperiment): Fetches variant run counts and score aggregates for one experiment on one function.
  - [List experiments](/v2/experiments/ListExperiments): Lists observed experiments in the authenticated environment. Use the nested app and function route to scope results to one function.

  - **Builds**
  - [List recent workspace builds](/v2/builds/ListBuilds)
  - [Get a build](/v2/builds/GetBuild)
  - [Cancel an unfinished build](/v2/builds/CancelBuild)
  - [Create a build](/v2/builds/CreateBuild): Upload one linux/amd64 docker-save tar or tar.gz to upload_url in a PUT request with every header in upload_headers, then commit the upload to start conversion. Requires image-build access.
  - [Commit an upload and start the build](/v2/builds/CommitBuild)

  - **Deploys**
  - [List recent workspace deploys](/v2/deploys/ListDeploys)
  - [Get a deploy](/v2/deploys/GetDeploy)
  - [Cancel an unfinished deploy](/v2/deploys/CancelDeploy)
  - [Create a deploy](/v2/deploys/CreateDeploy): Provide config from the selected apps entry in inngest.toml with exactly one of serve or connect. Memory defaults to 2048 MiB, CPU to 1 vCPU, and connect replicas to 1. Serve path defaults to /api/inngest and an omitted port is discovered from the image's exposed ports at launch. Omitted serve_config settings use node defaults. Upload one linux/amd64 docker-save tar or tar.gz to upload_url in a PUT request with every header in upload_headers, then commit the upload to build a function artifact. Runtime ENV, ENTRYPOINT, and CMD come from the image. Requires image-build access.
  - [Commit an upload and start the deploy](/v2/deploys/CommitDeploy)

  - **Webhooks**
  - [List webhooks](/v2/webhooks/ListWebhooks): Lists all webhooks in the specified environment
  - [Create webhook](/v2/webhooks/CreateWebhook): Creates a new webhook for receiving events

  - **Environments**
  - [List environments](/v2/environments/FetchAccountEnvs): List of all custom environments.
  - [Create environment](/v2/environments/CreateEnv): Create custom environment
  - [Update environment](/v2/environments/PatchEnv): Partially updates an environment. Only the provided fields will be modified.

  - **Events**
  - [List events](/v2/events/ListEvents): Lists events in descending internal-ID order, excluding internal inngest/ events. Time filters use received time; client-seeded IDs can differ from received-time order. Payloads are omitted unless include=payload. The dev server returns events stored in its database, which is in-memory by default and lost on restart. Cloud returns the same events as the dashboard and v1 API, subject to the plan's event retention.
  - [Send event](/v2/events/SendEvent): Sends one event for testing and debugging. The request accepts the name, data, user, id, and ts fields; send batches and other Event API fields through an Inngest SDK or the Event API. This endpoint uses REST API rate limits and is not intended for high-volume ingestion. Use the returned event ID with the event runs endpoint to inspect any function runs triggered by the event.
  - [Get an event](/v2/events/GetEvent): Gets an event by its internal ID. Internal inngest/ events are not returned. Payloads are omitted unless include=payload. The dev server returns events stored in its database, which is in-memory by default and lost on restart. Cloud returns the same events as the dashboard and v1 API, subject to the plan's event retention.

  - **Feedback**
  - [Submit product feedback](/v2/feedback/SubmitFeedback): Sends user-requested product feedback to Inngest support. Cloud only. Submit only feedback the user has asked to share; do not include credentials, secrets, or run payloads. Creates a support ticket, so retries may create duplicates. Requires feedback:write:create. No environment selection is required.

  - **Insights**
  - [List event type schemas](/v2/insights/ListInsightsEventSchemas): Returns a paginated list of event type schemas, where each schema describes the shape of a specific event's data as nested JSON.
  - [Query insights](/v2/insights/QueryInsights): Query Insights using the provided SQL query.
  - [Generate insights query from prompt](/v2/insights/QueryInsightsPrompt): Translates a natural language prompt into an Insights SQL query.
  - [List insights tables](/v2/insights/ListInsightsTables): Lists the available tables that can be queried via the Insights query endpoint.

  - **Keys**
  - [List account event keys](/v2/keys/FetchAccountEventKeys): Lists event keys for a specific account, optionally filtered by environment. If the environment header isn't specified, this returns the default production environment's keys.
  - [List account signing keys](/v2/keys/FetchAccountSigningKeys): Lists signing keys for a specific account, optionally filtered by environment.  If the environment header isn't specified, this returns the default production environment's keys.

  - **Partner API**
  - [List partner accounts](/v2/partner-api/FetchPartnerAccounts): Lists sub-accounts (if you have partner access)
  - [Create partner account](/v2/partner-api/CreatePartnerAccount): Creates a sub-account (if you have partner access)

  - **Sandboxes**
  - [List sandboxes](/v2/sandboxes/ListSandboxes)
  - [Create a sandbox](/v2/sandboxes/CreateSandbox)
  - [Get a sandbox](/v2/sandboxes/GetSandbox)
  - [Destroy a sandbox](/v2/sandboxes/DestroySandbox)
  - [Execute a command in a sandbox](/v2/sandboxes/ExecSandbox)
  - [Read a sandbox file](/v2/sandboxes/ReadSandboxFile)
  - [Write a sandbox file](/v2/sandboxes/WriteSandboxFile)
  - [Stream sandbox logs](/v2/sandboxes/StreamSandboxLogs)
  - [Pause a sandbox](/v2/sandboxes/PauseSandbox)
  - [List sandbox processes](/v2/sandboxes/ListSandboxProcesses)
  - [Start a sandbox process](/v2/sandboxes/StartSandboxProcess)
  - [Get a sandbox process](/v2/sandboxes/GetSandboxProcess)
  - [Get sandbox process output](/v2/sandboxes/GetSandboxProcessOutput)
  - [Stream sandbox process output](/v2/sandboxes/StreamSandboxProcessOutput)
  - [Signal a sandbox process](/v2/sandboxes/SignalSandboxProcess)
  - [Wait for a sandbox process](/v2/sandboxes/WaitSandboxProcess)
  - [Resume a sandbox](/v2/sandboxes/ResumeSandbox)
  - [Create a sandbox snapshot](/v2/sandboxes/CreateSandboxSnapshot)
  - [List sandbox snapshots](/v2/sandboxes/ListSandboxSnapshots)
  - [Get a sandbox snapshot](/v2/sandboxes/GetSandboxSnapshot)
  - [Delete a sandbox snapshot](/v2/sandboxes/DeleteSandboxSnapshot)

  - **Sessions**
  - [List session keys](/v2/sessions/ListSessionKeys): Lists session keys observed in the authenticated environment.
  - [List sessions](/v2/sessions/ListSessions): Lists session IDs for one session key in the authenticated environment.
  - [List session runs](/v2/sessions/ListSessionRuns): Lists runs associated with one session ID in the authenticated environment.
